title: Mika
body:
Listen. You who reading this or the developers! 
I have tried SO MANY! SO MANY Habit trackers to quit alcohol. 
And this app? The only one that has made me achieve that goal👏🏼
Those tough days I wanted to take just one sip? No. I couldnt because I needed to finish the campsite or the summit and see todays design!
This silly app with its silly design has made me so happy and better. 
Thank you!
author: michomarco
